name: UI/UX Design Fundamentals & Prototyping with Generative AI
description: Three-course specialization developed by SkillUp on Coursera. Covers foundational UI/UX methodologies, usability principles, user research, wireframing, and interactive prototyping using Figma, combined with generative AI tools to accelerate design workflows, automate layout variations, and optimize user experience.

criteria.narrative: Completed all three courses in the UI/UX Design Fundamentals & Prototyping with Generative AI Specialization on Coursera: (1) UX/UI Design Fundamentals: Usability and Visual Principles, (2) UI/UX Wireframing and Prototyping with Figma, and (3) Generative AI: The Future of UX/UI Design.
